feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Man punched Jewish woman in the face as she pushed baby in pram, court hears
articles.summary: A man accused of assaulting three Jewish women allegedly punched one of them in the face while she was pushing her daughter in a pram, a court heard.

articles.title: Amber warning issued ahead of Storm Austen
articles.summary: An amber wind warning has been issued for the South West of England on Friday, with gusts of up to 80mph expected.

articles.title: Actor Noel Clarke pleads not guilty to six sexual offences
articles.summary: Actor Noel Clarke has pleaded not guilty to six sexual offences.

articles.title: Teacher struck off after 'low-cut crop top' comment to schoolgirl
articles.summary: A former teacher has been struck off for telling a pupil he would attend a school production of Grease if she was wearing a "low-cut crop top and tight trousers".

articles.title: Boy, 16, found guilty of attempted murder after stabbing girl at school
articles.summary: A 16-year-old boy has been found guilty of attempted murder after stabbing a 15-year-old girl in the back at school.

articles.title: UK 'woefully unprepared' to face wildfires, MPs warn - as UN issues climate target warning
articles.summary: Exceeding a key global climate target is now "imminent and unavoidable", United Nations (UN) scientists have warned.

articles.title: Tough new rules on Brazilian butt lifts and chemical peels proposed
articles.summary: Brazilian butt lifts and other cosmetic procedures that inject filler into parts of the body will only be performed by doctors under new government rules to crackdown on "cosmetic cowboys".

articles.title: Two men re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran after RAF Fairford incident
articles.summary: Two men have been re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran’s intelligence service over a suspected terror plot near RAF Fairford.
